Material plus piece-square tables with endgame king interpolation gives positional play, MVV-LVA ordering plus captures-first quiescence gives tactics, immediate mate detection gives checkmate priority, and conservative move generation without history-dependent castling/en-passant guarantees legality with fallback to a legal move.
